briefing.headline: OpenAI and Google race to deploy agentic systems as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: The AI frontier intensified this week with multiple frontier labs pushing agentic capabilities. Funding surged past $12B in Q3 as compute constraints ease slightly. Regulatory pressure mounts amid rising exploit reports.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4-preview with enhanced tool-use while Anthropic launched Claude 4 Opus. Google DeepMind deployed Gemini 3.0 agents and Meta open-sourced Llama 4 weights. xAI and DeepSeek continue scaling.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and IoT deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: TSMC ramped 3nm AI chip production for NVIDIA and AMD. Microsoft announced new $5B data center in Texas while Oracle expanded sovereign cloud regions for European AI workloads.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will agentic AI systems trigger the first major cross-border cyber incident before 2027?
